name: Roth.extend_apply_castSucc
signature:
private lemma extend_apply_castSucc {m : ℕ} (d : Fin m →₀ ℕ) (i : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    (d.mapDomain Fin.castSucc + Finsupp.single (Fin.last m) i) j.castSucc = d j
what: Extending an exponent vector by a prescribed last coordinate leaves its earlier coordinates unchanged.
how: Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective computes the embedded earlier coordinate and the disjoint single last-coordinate contribution vanishes.
hypotheses: A finite coordinate set Fin m, a finitely supported vector, and a natural last coordinate.
